nodes.notes: Firstborn son of Moses & Zipporah (daughter of Jethro of Midian).

nodes.name: Eliezer (son of Moses)
nodes.notes: Second son of Moses & Zipporah.

nodes.name: Er
nodes.notes: 1st son of Judah & Shua's daughter (Gen 38:3).

nodes.name: Onan
nodes.notes: 2nd son of Judah (Gen 38:4).

nodes.name: Shelah (son of Judah)
nodes.notes: 3rd son of Judah (Gen 38:5).

nodes.name: Zerah (son of Judah)
nodes.notes: Twin son of Judah & Tamar (Gen 38:30); linked in some classical/Irish traditions to Mediterranean migrations.

nodes.name: Perez (Pharez)
nodes.notes: Twin son of Judah & Tamar; direct ancestor of Boaz, King David, and the royal Davidic line.

nodes.name: Hezron → Ram → Nahshon → Boaz (+ Ruth) → Jesse
nodes.role: Bridge from Perez to Davidic Dynasty (Uniting Judah & Moab)
nodes.notes: Boaz marries Ruth the Moabitess (descendant of Lot!), uniting the Israelite line of Judah with the Moabite line of Lot.

nodes.name: King David
nodes.role: King of Israel & Founder of Davidic Dynasty
nodes.notes: Son of Jesse; father of Solomon, Absalom, Adonijah, Nathan, and Tamar.

nodes.name: King Solomon (Shlomo)
nodes.notes: Father of Rehoboam (Judah). In Ethiopia's national epic Kebra Nagast, Solomon and Makeda (Queen of Sheba) parent Menelik I, bridging Israel, Arabia/Sheba, and Ethiopia!

nodes.name: Menelik I (Solomonic Dynasty of Ethiopia)
nodes.notes: Son of King Solomon and Queen Makeda of Sheba (Saba). Creates a famous African-Arabian-Israelite royal genealogy bridging Cush/Ethiopia, Sheba, and Judah!

nodes.name: Manasseh (son of Joseph)
nodes.notes: Firstborn of Joseph & Asenath (daughter of Poti-phera, Priest of On).

nodes.name: Ephraim (son of Joseph)
nodes.notes: Second son of Joseph & Asenath; ancestor of Joshua.

nodes.name: Nun (Primeval Waters) → Atum / Ra (Re)
nodes.notes: Atum-Ra emerges from the primeval flood-waters of Nun (often compared to cosmic Flood waters) to generate Shu & Tefnut.

nodes.name: Ptah (Creator of Memphis — Hikuptah)
nodes.role: Creator Deity of Memphis / Eponym of Egypt & Naphtuhim
nodes.notes: Manetho places Ptah (Hephaestus) at the head of Egypt's divine kings! His temple Hikuptah ('House of the Ka of Ptah') gave Greece the word 'Aigyptos' (Egypt), and 'Na-Ptah' ('People of Ptah') is the exact linguistic cognate of Biblical Naphtuhim (Gen 10:13)!

nodes.name: Shu & Tefnut → Geb & Nut
nodes.notes: Parents of Osiris, Isis, Set, and Nephthys — recorded as divine pre-dynastic sovereigns in the Turin King List.

nodes.name: Osiris (Usir) & Isis (Aset) / Set & Nephthys
nodes.notes: Osiris reigns as Egypt's first mortal-like civilizing king, is sealed in a chest/ark floated down the Nile by Set (compared by syncretists to Noah's Ark!), and resurrects via Isis to sire Horus. Nephthys & Osiris/Set parent Anubis.

nodes.name: Horus (Heru) & Shemsu-Hor ('Followers of Horus')
nodes.role: Living Prototype of Every Egyptian Pharaoh
nodes.notes: Son of Osiris & Isis; rules Egypt before passing sovereignty through the Shemsu-Hor ('Followers of Horus' / demigods) to Narmer/Menes.

nodes.name: Thoth (Djehuty / Hermes) & King Saurid (Surid)
nodes.role: Scribe of the Gods / Antediluvian Pyramid Builder
nodes.notes: Manetho lists Thoth (Hermes) among Egypt's divine sovereigns. Greco-Egyptian, Hermetic, and Coptic-Arabic histories explicitly identify Biblical Enoch (Idris) with Thoth / Hermes Trismegistus and antediluvian King Saurid, who foresaw the Flood and built the Pyramids to preserve astronomy!

nodes.name: Hujib → Philemon (Aflimun, Egyptian Priest on Noah's Ark)
nodes.notes: Coptic-Arabic chronicles describe Philemon (descendant/priest of King Saurid's line) joining Noah on the Ark and guiding Ham's grandson Misrayim (Mizraim) back to resettle Egypt after the Flood!

nodes.name: Baysar → Misrayim (Misr) → Qift (Copts), Ashmun, Atrib & Sa
nodes.notes: Medieval Coptic-Arabic histories trace post-Flood Egypt from Ham -> Baysar -> Misrayim (Mizraim), whose 4 sons Qift (eponym of the Copts/Qift!), Ashmun (Hermopolis), Atrib (Athribis), and Sa (Sais) divide Egypt!

nodes.name: Rikayon (First 'Pharaoh' in Book of Jasher) → Melol → Adikam
nodes.role: Extra-Biblical Pharaohs of Abraham, Joseph & Moses
nodes.notes: Book of Jasher 14 recounts Rikayon rising to power in Shinar/Egypt and receiving the title 'Pharaoh', followed in later generations by King Melol (Pharaoh at Moses's birth, father of Princess Bithiah) and short-statured King Adikam (Pharaoh of the Exodus!).

nodes.name: Protogonos → Misor & Sydyk → Taaut (Thoth) & Chna (Canaan)
sources: Philo of Byblos / Sanchuniathon (via Eusebius Praep. Ev. I.10)
nodes.notes: Explicitly names Misor (direct cognate of Biblical Mizraim!) as brother of Sydyk (cf. Melchizedek) and father of Taaut (Egyptian Thoth), alongside Chna (Canaan).

nodes.name: Narmer / Menes (Unifier of Upper & Lower Egypt)
nodes.role: First Historical Pharaoh of Unified Egypt
nodes.notes: Unified Upper and Lower Egypt and founded Memphis (city of Ptah); historical anchor for the land of Mizraim.

nodes.name: Hor-Aha → Djer → Djet & Queen Merneith
nodes.notes: Hor-Aha (son of Narmer) -> Djer -> Djet + Regent Queen Merneith (first known female ruler/regent in Egyptian history!).

nodes.name: Den → Anedjib → Semerkhet → Qa'a (Late Dynasty 1)
nodes.notes: Den (son of Djet & Merneith) first wore the Double Crown of Egypt; followed by Anedjib, Semerkhet, and Qa'a.

nodes.name: Hotepsekhemwy → Peribsen → Khasekhemwy & Nimaathap
nodes.role: Reconciler of Horus & Set / Parents of Djoser
nodes.notes: Khasekhemwy reunited Egypt under both Horus and Set symbols; with Queen Nimaathap he founded the line leading to 3rd Dynasty pyramid builders!

nodes.name: Djoser (Netjerikhet) — Builder of Step Pyramid
nodes.role: Founder of Old Kingdom Pyramid Age
nodes.notes: Commissioned the world's first monumental stone pyramid at Saqqara through his vizier Imhotep.

nodes.name: Imhotep (Vizier of Djoser / 7-Year Famine Stela)
nodes.role: Architect, Physician, Priest of On & Famine Vizier
nodes.notes: High Priest of Heliopolis (On) and vizier of Djoser. The Sehel Island Famine Stela credits Imhotep with ending a 7-year Nile famine — famously compared to Joseph (Zaphenath-Paneah), who wed the daughter of the Priest of On!

nodes.name: Huni → Sneferu & Queen Hetepheres I
nodes.role: Builder of Bent & Red Pyramids / Father of Khufu
nodes.notes: Sneferu built three giant pyramids (Meidum, Bent, Red) and with Hetepheres I fathered Khufu.

nodes.name: Khufu (Cheops) — Great Pyramid of Giza
nodes.notes: Son of Sneferu & Hetepheres I; commissioned the Great Pyramid of Giza (attributed in Coptic-Arabic folklore to antediluvian King Saurid/Enoch!). Father of Djedefre and Khafre.

nodes.name: Djedefre, Khafre (Sphinx) → Menkaure → Shepseskaf
nodes.notes: Sons of Khufu (Djedefre & Khafre, builder of 2nd Giza Pyramid & Great Sphinx) -> Menkaure (3rd Giza Pyramid) -> Shepseskaf.

nodes.name: Userkaf → Unas (Pyramid Texts) → Pepi I → Pepi II & Nitocris
nodes.role: Solar Kings & Old Kingdom Pyramid Texts
nodes.notes: Unas inscribed the world's oldest surviving religious corpus (Pyramid Texts); Pepi II reigned ~94 years before the Old Kingdom collapsed.

nodes.name: Mentuhotep II → Amenemhat I → Senusret I
nodes.notes: Mentuhotep II reunites Egypt; Amenemhat I & Senusret I inaugurate the Middle Kingdom (the Beni Hasan tomb depicts Semitic Aamu caravans entering Egypt in this exact era, paralleling Abraham & Jacob!).

nodes.name: Senusret II → Senusret III → Amenemhat III → Sobekneferu
nodes.role: Peak of Middle Kingdom & Faiyum Canal
nodes.notes: Senusret III expands into Nubia (Kush); Amenemhat III builds the Faiyum irrigation system (later called Bahr Yussef, 'Canal of Joseph' in Egyptian tradition!); Sobekneferu is the first verified female Pharaoh.

nodes.name: Salitis → Khyan → Apepi (15th Dynasty Hyksos)
nodes.role: West-Semitic Rulers of Avaris in the Nile Delta
nodes.notes: Canaanite/West-Semitic kings ruling Lower Egypt from Avaris (Goshen/Delta!). Both Manetho and Josephus linked the Hyksos era to the arrival/expulsion of the Israelites under Joseph and Moses.

nodes.name: Seqenenre Tao (+ Ahhotep I) → Kamose
nodes.notes: Theban royal family who fought to expel the Hyksos from Avaris; parents of Ahmose I (founder of the New Kingdom).

nodes.name: Ahmose I (+ Ahmose-Nefertari) → Amenhotep I
nodes.role: Founder of the New Kingdom (Expeller of Hyksos)
sources: Tomb of Ahmose son of Ibana
nodes.notes: Son of Seqenenre Tao & Ahhotep I; expels the Hyksos from Avaris and conquers Sharuhen in Canaan.

nodes.name: Thutmose I → Thutmose II & Queen Hatshepsut
nodes.notes: Thutmose I campaigns to the Euphrates and Kush; daughter Hatshepsut rules as Pharaoh and dispatches the famed expedition to the Land of Punt (East Africa/Horn of Africa) — sometimes compared in early-Exodus chronology to Pharaoh's daughter who raised Moses!

nodes.name: Thutmose III → Amenhotep II → Thutmose IV
nodes.role: Peak of Egyptian Empire in Canaan & Nubia
nodes.notes: Thutmose III wins the Battle of Megiddo in Canaan and extends Egyptian rule from the Euphrates to the 4th Cataract of Nubia.

nodes.name: Amenhotep III & Queen Tiye
nodes.role: Golden Age Pharaoh & Powerful Royal Matriarch
nodes.notes: Corresponded with Babylon, Assyria, Mitanni, and Canaanite vassals (Amarna Letters mentioning 'Habiru'!). With Queen Tiye fathered Akhenaten.

nodes.name: Akhenaten (Amenhotep IV) & Nefertiti
nodes.notes: Son of Amenhotep III & Tiye; established solar monotheism at Akhetaten (Amarna). Frequently linked in comparative history (e.g., Psalm 104 <-> Great Hymn to Aten; Manetho's Osarseph memory) to the Mosaic era!

nodes.name: Tutankhamun (+ Ankhesenamun) → Ay → Horemheb
nodes.notes: Son of Akhenaten; marries half-sister Ankhesenamun (who famously wrote to Hittite King Suppiluliuma I asking for a Hittite prince to marry — bridging Egypt and Heth/Hittites!).

nodes.name: Ramesses I → Seti I → Ramesses II the Great (+ Nefertari)
nodes.role: Builder of Pi-Ramesses & Battle of Kadesh
nodes.notes: Built the Delta capital Pi-Ramesses (named 'Raamses' in Exodus 1:11!) and signed history's oldest surviving peace treaty with the Hittites (Hattusili III). Most widely cited Pharaoh of the late-date Exodus!

nodes.name: Merneptah (Israel Stele, c. 1208 BCE)
nodes.role: 13th Son of Ramesses II / Earliest Inscription of Israel
nodes.notes: Son of Ramesses II; his 1208 BCE Victory Stele contains the earliest extra-biblical mention of 'Israel' as a people in Canaan!

nodes.name: Ramesses III (Defender Against Sea Peoples / Peleset)
nodes.notes: Repelled the Sea Peoples invasion including the Peleset (Philistines — Caphtorim/Casluhim of Gen 10:14!), who subsequently settled coastal Canaan!

nodes.name: Shoshenq I (Biblical Shishak, 22nd Libyan Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Founder of the Libyan (Phut/Lehabim) 22nd Dynasty; explicitly named 'Shishak' in 1 Kings 14:25, sheltering Jeroboam and campaigning in Judah and Israel after Solomon's death!

nodes.name: Ptolemy I → Ptolemy II (Manetho & LXX) → Cleopatra VII
nodes.role: Hellenistic Pharaohs & Translators of the Septuagint
nodes.notes: Under Ptolemy II Philadelphus, Jewish scholars translated the Torah into Greek (Septuagint) at Alexandria while Egyptian priest Manetho compiled the 30-dynasty history of Egypt and the Osarseph/Moses account; ends with Cleopatra VII.

nodes.name: Osarseph (Manetho) / Musaeus (Artapanus) / Bithiah & Adoniah
nodes.notes: Manetho preserves an Egyptian tradition of a Heliopolitan priest named Osarseph who took the name Moses; Artapanus calls Moses 'Musaeus' (teacher of Orpheus) and Egyptian 'Hermes', leading an expedition into Cush/Ethiopia — echoing Book of Jasher 72-76 where Moses rules Cush with Queen Adoniah!

nodes.name: Apsu & Tiamat
nodes.notes: Primordial cosmic waters whose mingling generates the elder gods Lahmu and Lahamu.

nodes.name: Lahmu & Lahamu
nodes.notes: Born of Apsu & Tiamat; parents of Anshar & Kishar.

nodes.name: Anshar & Kishar
nodes.notes: Parents of the Sky Father Anu.

nodes.name: Anu (An) & Antu / Ki
nodes.notes: Supreme sky deity of Uruk; father of Enki (Ea) and Enlil.

nodes.name: Enki (Ea) & Damkina (Ninhursag)
nodes.role: Creator of Humanity & Protector of Flood Survivor
nodes.notes: Patron of Eridu; with Nintu/Belet-ili fashions the first humans (Lullu) from clay mixed with divine blood, and secretly warns Ziusudra/Atrahasis of the Flood.

nodes.name: Enlil & Ninlil
nodes.notes: Father of Nanna (Sin) and Ninurta; decrees the Deluge in Atrahasis.

nodes.name: Marduk (Bel)
nodes.notes: Son of Enki (Ea) & Damkina; slays Tiamat, builds Babylon, and fashions humanity from Qingu's blood.

nodes.name: Nabu (Scribe God of Borsippa)
nodes.notes: Son of Marduk; keeper of the Tablets of Destiny and patron of scribes.

nodes.name: Ninurta (Ningirsu)
nodes.notes: Mythic hunter and champion of the gods — widely proposed by Assyriologists as a mythological source for Biblical Nimrod ('mighty hunter')!

nodes.name: Nanna (Sin — Moon God of Ur)
nodes.notes: Moon god of Ur; marries Ningal and fathers Utu (Shamash) and Inanna (Ishtar).

nodes.name: Utu (Shamash — Sun God of Sippar/Larsa)
nodes.notes: Son of Nanna; reveals celestial tablets to 7th king Enmeduranki at Sippar and fathers Meskiaggasher of Uruk!

nodes.name: Inanna (Ishtar — Queen of Heaven)
nodes.notes: Patron goddess of Uruk (Eanna) and consort of Dumuzid.

nodes.name: Lullu (First Humans) & Adapa / Uanna (1st Apkallu)
nodes.notes: Lullu is fashioned from clay + divine blood of We-ilu/Qingu. Adapa (1st Apkallu sage under Alulim, called Oannes by Berossus) ascends to heaven and forfeits eternal life — widely compared to Adam!

nodes.name: 1. Alulim (Aloros of Eridu)
nodes.notes: 1st Antediluvian King of Eridu; advised by 1st Apkallu sage Uanna/Adapa.

nodes.name: 2. Alalngar (Alaparos of Eridu)
nodes.notes: 2nd Antediluvian King of Eridu; sage Uannedugga.

nodes.name: 3. En-men-lu-ana (Amelon of Bad-tibira)
nodes.notes: 3rd Antediluvian King; kingship moves to Bad-tibira; sage Enmedugga.

nodes.name: 4. En-men-gal-ana (Ammenon of Bad-tibira)
nodes.notes: 4th Antediluvian King of Bad-tibira; sage Enmegalamma.

nodes.name: 5. Dumuzid the Shepherd (Daonos)
nodes.notes: 5th Antediluvian King of Bad-tibira; sage Enmebulugga.

nodes.name: 6. En-sipad-zid-ana (Amempsinos of Larak)
nodes.notes: 6th Antediluvian King; kingship moves to Larak; sage An-Enlilda.

nodes.name: 7. En-men-dur-ana (Enmeduranki of Sippar)
nodes.notes: 7th Antediluvian King (Euedorachos in Berossus); ruler of sun-city Sippar, initiated by Shamash & Adad into heavenly secrets and divination alongside 7th sage Utuabzu (who ascends to heaven) — exact structural parallel to Enoch (7th patriarch, 365 solar years)!

nodes.name: 8. Megalaros / Amegalaros (Berossus)
nodes.notes: Included in Berossus's 10-king antediluvian list (matching Genesis 5's 10 patriarchs).

nodes.name: 9. Ubara-Tutu (Otiartes of Shuruppak)
nodes.notes: Last king of Shuruppak before the Deluge; father of Ziusudra / Utnapishtim!

nodes.name: 10. Ziusudra / Utnapishtim / Atrahasis
nodes.notes: 10th Antediluvian ruler (Xisouthros in Berossus). Warned by Enki/Ea of the Deluge; builds a vessel preserving family and animals; releases dove, swallow, and raven; lands on Mt. Nimush.

nodes.name: Utuabzu (7th Apkallu Sage Who Ascended to Heaven)
nodes.notes: The 7th antediluvian sage, counselor to 7th king Enmeduranki, explicitly recorded as 'having ascended to heaven' — a stunning Mesopotamian parallel to Enoch (7th from Adam, taken to heaven)!

nodes.name: Jushur (1st Post-Flood King of Kish)
nodes.notes: First king after the Flood swept over and kingship descended from heaven anew at Kish.

nodes.name: Kullassina-bel
nodes.notes: 2nd king of Kish I ('All of them were lord').

nodes.name: Nangishlishma
nodes.notes: 3rd king of Kish I.

nodes.name: En-tarah-ana
nodes.notes: 4th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Babum
nodes.notes: 5th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Puannum
nodes.notes: 6th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Kalibum
nodes.notes: 7th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Kalumum
nodes.notes: 8th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Zuqaqip ('Scorpion')
nodes.notes: 9th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Atab
nodes.notes: 10th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Mashda (son of Atab)
nodes.notes: 11th king of Kish I; son of Atab.

nodes.name: Arwium (son of Mashda)
nodes.notes: 12th king of Kish I; son of Mashda.

nodes.name: Etana of Kish (Ascended on an Eagle)
nodes.notes: 13th king of Kish I; 'the shepherd who ascended to heaven and consolidated all foreign countries' on an eagle's back to obtain the Plant of Birth.

nodes.name: Balih (son of Etana)
nodes.notes: 14th king of Kish I; son of Etana.

nodes.name: En-me-nuna
nodes.notes: 15th king of Kish I; father of Melem-Kish and Barsal-nuna.

nodes.name: Melem-Kish (son of En-me-nuna)
nodes.notes: 16th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Barsal-nuna (son of En-me-nuna)
nodes.notes: 17th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Zamug (son of Barsal-nuna)
nodes.notes: 18th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Tizqar (son of Zamug)
nodes.notes: 19th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Ilku
nodes.notes: 20th king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Iltasadum
nodes.notes: 21st king of Kish I.

nodes.name: Enmebaragesi of Kish (Conqueror of Elam)
nodes.era: First Dynasty of Kish • c. 2600 BCE
nodes.notes: 22nd king of Kish I; earliest Sumerian king confirmed by contemporary inscriptions! 'Carried away as spoil the weapons of Elam'.

nodes.name: Aga (Agga) of Kish
nodes.era: First Dynasty of Kish • c. 2600 BCE
nodes.notes: 23rd and final king of Kish I; son of Enmebaragesi, besieged Uruk and clashed with Gilgamesh.

nodes.name: Meskiaggasher (Founder of Uruk / Erech)
nodes.role: Son of Sun God Utu (Shamash) / 1st King of Uruk
nodes.notes: High priest and king of Eanna; 'entered the sea and ascended to the mountains'. Father of Enmerkar.

nodes.name: Enmerkar (Builder of Uruk / Erech)
nodes.role: 2nd King of Uruk / Inventor of Cuneiform
sources: Enmerkar and the Lord of Aratta
nodes.notes: Son of Meskiaggasher; built Uruk (Biblical Erech, Gen 10:10) and invented cuneiform clay tablets in rivalry with Aratta (Iranian plateau!). Widely compared to Nimrod ('Enmer the Hunter').

nodes.name: Lugalbanda & Goddess Ninsun
nodes.role: 3rd King of Uruk / Father of Gilgamesh
nodes.notes: Companion of Enmerkar; weds goddess Ninsun and fathers Gilgamesh.

nodes.name: Dumuzid the Fisherman (of Kuara)
nodes.notes: Captured Enmebaragesi of Kish single-handedly before Gilgamesh.

nodes.name: Gilgamesh (Bilgamesh of Uruk / Erech)
nodes.role: 5th King of Uruk / Builder of Uruk's Walls / Qumran Giant
nodes.notes: Son of Lugalbanda & Ninsun; visits Flood survivor Utnapishtim. Uruk is explicitly 'Erech' in Gen 10:10 — and 'Gilgamesh' is literally named as a Giant in Qumran Book of Giants (4Q530)!

nodes.name: Ur-Nungal (son of Gilgamesh)
nodes.notes: 6th king of Uruk I; son of Gilgamesh (reigned 30 yrs).

nodes.name: Udul-kalama (son of Ur-Nungal)
nodes.notes: 7th king of Uruk I; grandson of Gilgamesh (15 yrs).

nodes.name: La-ba'shum
nodes.notes: 8th king of Uruk I (9 yrs).

nodes.name: En-nun-tarah-ana
nodes.notes: 9th king of Uruk I (8 yrs).

nodes.name: Mesh-he
nodes.notes: 10th king of Uruk I (36 yrs).

nodes.name: Melem-ana
nodes.notes: 11th king of Uruk I (6 yrs).

nodes.name: Lugal-kitun
nodes.notes: 12th and final king of Uruk I (36 yrs).

nodes.name: Mesannepada (Founder of Ur I)
nodes.role: 1st King of First Dynasty of Ur
nodes.notes: Overthrew Uruk I; attested by royal seals from Ur.

nodes.name: Mesh-ki-ang-nanna (son of Mesannepada)
nodes.notes: Son of Mesannepada; followed by Elulu and Balulu.

nodes.name: Sargon of Akkad (Sharru-kin)
nodes.notes: Cupbearer of Ur-Zababa of Kish who founded the world's first empire (Biblical Accad, Gen 10:10). His Birth Legend ('reed basket sealed with bitumen on the river') parallels Moses in Exodus 2!

nodes.name: Enheduanna (High Priestess of Ur)
nodes.role: Daughter of Sargon / Earliest Named Author in History
nodes.notes: Daughter of Sargon of Akkad appointed High Priestess of Nanna at Ur; world's earliest known named author!

nodes.name: Rimush (son of Sargon)
nodes.notes: Son of Sargon; campaigned against rebellious Sumerian cities and Elam.

nodes.name: Manishtushu (son of Sargon)
nodes.notes: Son of Sargon; father of Naram-Sin.

nodes.name: Naram-Sin ('King of the Four Quarters')
nodes.notes: Son of Manishtushu; peak of Akkadian Empire.

nodes.name: Shar-Kali-Sharri (son of Naram-Sin)
nodes.notes: Son of Naram-Sin; reigned as the Akkadian Empire faced Gutian invasions.

nodes.name: Ur-Nammu (Founder of Ur III — Ur of the Chaldees)
nodes.role: Builder of Great Ziggurat / Oldest Law Code
nodes.notes: Founded Ur III and issued history's oldest surviving law code — the exact historical era of Ur of the Chaldees before Terah & Abraham's migration (Gen 11:31)!

nodes.name: Shulgi (son of Ur-Nammu)
nodes.notes: Son of Ur-Nammu; reigned 48 years, standardized weights, measures, and scribal academies.

nodes.name: Amar-Sin (son of Shulgi)
nodes.notes: Son of Shulgi.

nodes.name: Shu-Sin (brother/son of Amar-Sin)
nodes.notes: Built the Martu Wall to hold back western Amorite tribes.

nodes.name: Ibbi-Sin (Last King of Ur III)
nodes.role: 5th King of Ur III (Fall of Ur to Elam)
nodes.notes: Ur fell to Elamite and Shimashki invaders in 2004 BCE — matching the historical backdrop of Terah & Abraham leaving Ur!

nodes.name: Sumu-abum → Sumu-la-El → Sin-Muballit (Early Babylon)
nodes.notes: Amorite chieftains who established the First Dynasty of Babylon: Sumu-abum -> Sumu-la-El -> Sabium -> Apil-Sin -> Sin-Muballit (father of Hammurabi).

nodes.name: Hammurabi of Babylon (→ Samsu-iluna)
nodes.notes: 6th king of the Amorite Dynasty of Babylon; unified Mesopotamia and issued the Code of Hammurabi. Father of Samsu-iluna.

nodes.name: Tudiya → Ushpia → Shamshi-Adad I → Tukulti-Ninurta I → Ashurbanipal
nodes.notes: Begins with '17 Kings Who Lived in Tents' (Tudiya -> Ushpia) and leads to Tukulti-Ninurta I (often cited as a historical prototype for Nimrod!), Sennacherib, and Ashurbanipal (whose library preserved Gilgamesh & Enuma Elish!).

nodes.name: Gayomart (Gaya Maretan / Keyumars)
nodes.role: First Mortal Human & First Pishdadian King
nodes.notes: Created by Ahura Mazda ('Mortal Life'). From his seed purified in the earth grew a rhubarb plant splitting into Mashya and Mashyana.

nodes.name: Mashya & Mashyana
nodes.role: First Human Couple (7 Pairs of Twins)
nodes.notes: Twin first man and woman who bore 7 pairs of twins, including Siamak & Nashak (ancestors of Iran) and Fravak & Fravakain (ancestors of all 15 human races!).

nodes.name: Fravak & Fravakain (Zoroastrian Table of Nations)
nodes.role: Progenitors of the 15 Races Across 7 Climes
nodes.notes: Bundahishn Ch. 14 traces 15 distinct human nations across the 7 climes (karshvars) to Fravak & Fravakain — including Iranians (Hoshang), Arabs (Taz), Mazandaran, India, Turan, China (Chin), and the West (Rum)!

nodes.name: Taz & Tazag (Arabs / Taziks)
nodes.notes: Son of Fravak; eponym of the Arabian peoples (Middle Persian Tazig) and ancestor of Merdas -> Zahhak!

nodes.name: Mazandarani (Caspian Lineage)
nodes.notes: One of the races descended from Fravak in Bundahishn Ch. 14.

nodes.name: Hindug (Indians in Bundahishn)
nodes.notes: Branch of humanity settling India from Fravak's 15 pairs.

nodes.name: Chin (China in Bundahishn)
nodes.notes: Branch of humanity settling East Asia/China in Zoroastrian ethnography.

nodes.name: Arum / Rum (Western Peoples)
nodes.notes: Branch settling the western Mediterranean/Anatolian clime.

nodes.name: Merdas (Arabian King, desc. of Taz)
nodes.notes: Pious Arabian king descended from Taz, slain by his own son Zahhak under Ahriman's deception.

nodes.name: Zahhak (Azi Dahaka)
nodes.role: Dragon Usurper King of Babylon & Iran
nodes.notes: Son of Merdas; overthrows Jamshid and rules 1,000 years from Bawri (Babylon!) before being bound on Mt. Damavand by Fereydun. Ancestor of Mehrab Kaboli -> Rudabeh (mother of Rostam!).

nodes.name: Siamak & Nashak
nodes.notes: Slain by the Black Div; avenged by his son Hushang.

nodes.name: Hushang (Haoshyangha) & Guzak
nodes.notes: Founder of the Pishdadian ('First Lawgivers') dynasty; establishes Sadeh upon discovering fire.

nodes.name: Tahmuras (Takhma Urupi)
nodes.notes: Binds Ahriman for 30 years and learns 30 scripts from captive demons to teach humanity.

nodes.name: Vivanghant (Vivanhao)
nodes.notes: EXACT Proto-Indo-Iranian linguistic & genealogical cognate of Vedic Vivasvan (Surya)! Strongest verified prehistoric ancestral bridge between Iran and India.

nodes.name: Yima Khshaeta (Jamshid) & Yimak
nodes.role: 4th Pishdadian King & Builder of the Vara
nodes.notes: Son of Vivanghant — exact cognate of Vedic Yama! Builds the subterranean Vara preserving pairs of humans, animals, and seeds against the great cosmic winter/meltwater cataclysm.

nodes.name: Shahrnaz & Arnavaz (Daughters of Jamshid)
nodes.role: Wives of Fereydun / Mothers of Salm, Tur & Iraj
nodes.notes: Daughters/sisters of Jamshid rescued from Zahhak by Fereydun; Shahrnaz bears Salm & Tur, and Arnavaz bears Iraj!

nodes.name: Athwya (Abtin) & Faranak
nodes.role: Father of Fereydun / Exact Cognate of Vedic Aptya
nodes.notes: Descendant of Jamshid (via Pur-Tora/Sog-Tora in Bundahishn 35); EXACT Proto-Indo-Iranian cognate of Vedic Aptya (father of Trita Aptya)!

nodes.name: Fereydun (Thraetaona)
nodes.role: Binder of Zahhak & Divider of the World Into Three
nodes.notes: Son of Athwya (Abtin) & Faranak — cognate of Vedic Trita! Weds Shahrnaz & Arnavaz, binds Zahhak on Mt. Damavand, and divides the world among Salm, Tur, and Iraj.

nodes.name: Salm (Ruler of the West / Rum)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Fereydun & Shahrnaz; receives Rum/West.

nodes.name: Tur (Ruler of Turan / Central Asia)
nodes.notes: Second son of Fereydun & Shahrnaz; receives Central Asia & Steppe.

nodes.name: Zadsham (son of Tur)
nodes.notes: Father of Pashang.

nodes.name: Pashang (King of Turan)
nodes.notes: Son of Zadsham; launches the great Iran-Turan wars.

nodes.name: Afrasiab (Franrasyan)
nodes.role: Great King of Turan / Grandfather of Kay Khosrow
nodes.notes: Son of Pashang; legendary rival of Iran whose daughter Farangis marries Siyavash, uniting Iran and Turan in Kay Khosrow!

nodes.name: Garsivaz & Aghriras (Brothers of Afrasiab)
nodes.notes: Aghriras (noble brother who saved Iranian captives) and Garsivaz (instigator of Siyavash's murder).

nodes.name: Farangis (Turanian Princess)
nodes.role: Wife of Siyavash / Mother of Kay Khosrow
nodes.notes: Daughter of Afrasiab; marries Iranian prince Siyavash and gives birth to Kay Khosrow, uniting Turan and Iran!

nodes.name: Iraj (Ruler of Iran / Eranshahr)
nodes.role: 3rd Son of Fereydun / Eponym of Iran
nodes.notes: Youngest son of Fereydun & Arnavaz; receives Iran. Slain by Salm & Tur.

nodes.name: Mah-Afarid (Daughter of Iraj)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Iraj wed to Pashang (nephew of Fereydun), preserving Iraj's bloodline into Manuchehr.

nodes.name: Manuchehr (Manushchihr)
nodes.role: Avenger of Iraj / Ancestor of Kayanians & Zoroaster
nodes.notes: Avenges Iraj against Salm & Tur; defines Iran's border via Arash the Archer's legendary shot!

nodes.name: Nowzar (son of Manuchehr)
nodes.notes: Slain by Afrasiab; his sons Tus and Gostaham become leading Iranian generals.

nodes.name: Tus & Gostaham (Sons of Nowzar)
nodes.notes: Sons of Nowzar who serve the Kayanian kings.

nodes.name: Zav (Uzava, son of Tahmasp)
nodes.notes: Descendant of Manuchehr who restores agriculture after Afrasiab's drought.

nodes.name: Garshasp (Keresaspa — Dragon-Slayer)
nodes.notes: Avestan champion and final Pishdadian ruler; ancestor of the Sistan paladins (Nariman -> Sam -> Zal -> Rostam).

nodes.name: Nariman (son of Garshasp)
nodes.notes: Warrior ancestor of the House of Sistan.

nodes.name: Sam (Paladin of Iran)
nodes.notes: Champion under Manuchehr; initially abandoned his white-haired infant Zal on Mt. Alborz before reclaiming him from the Simurgh.

nodes.name: Zal (Dastan — Raised by the Simurgh)
nodes.notes: White-haired sage-warrior raised by the mythical Simurgh; weds Rudabeh of Kabul.

nodes.name: Mehrab Kaboli (King of Kabul)
nodes.role: Descendant of Zahhak / Father of Rudabeh
nodes.notes: Ruler of Kabul descended from Zahhak; father of Rudabeh.

nodes.name: Rudabeh (Princess of Kabul)
nodes.role: Wife of Zal / Mother of Rostam
nodes.notes: Her union with Zal bridges Kabul/Zahhak's line with Iran's greatest heroic house!

nodes.name: Rostam (Champion of Iran)
nodes.notes: Son of Zal & Rudabeh; serves the Kayanian kings for centuries. Marries Tahmineh of Samangan (Turan) -> Sohrab, plus Faramarz and warrior daughter Banu Goshasp.

nodes.name: Shaghad (Half-Brother of Rostam)
nodes.notes: Rostam's treacherous half-brother who conspires with the King of Kabul.

nodes.name: Sohrab (son of Rostam & Tahmineh)
nodes.role: Son of Rostam & Turanian Princess Tahmineh
nodes.notes: Born in Samangan (Turan); tragically slain in single combat by his father Rostam before they recognize one another.

nodes.name: Faramarz & Banu Goshasp (Children of Rostam)
nodes.notes: Faramarz leads expeditions into India and avenges Rostam; Banu Goshasp is a celebrated Iranian warrior heroine.

nodes.name: Kay Kavad (Kavi Kavata)
nodes.notes: Descendant of Manuchehr brought from Mt. Alborz by Rostam; father of Kay Kavus and Kay Apiveh.

nodes.name: Kay Apiveh → Kay Arash & Kay Pishin
nodes.notes: Branch of Kay Kavad leading to Kay Lohrasp and Kay Goshtasp (patron of Zoroaster).

nodes.name: Kay Kavus (Kavi Usan)
nodes.notes: Linguistic cognate of Vedic sage Kavi Ushanas! Father of Prince Siyavash.

nodes.name: Siyavash (Syavarshan)
nodes.role: Son of Kay Kavus / Husband of Farangis
nodes.notes: Passes through fire unscathed; weds Afrasiab's daughter Farangis in Turan; father of Kay Khosrow and Farud.

nodes.name: Farud (son of Siyavash & Jarireh)
nodes.notes: Son of Siyavash and Jarireh (daughter of Turanian sage Piran Viseh).

nodes.name: Kay Khosrow (Kavi Husravah)
nodes.role: Ideal Sacred King of Avesta & Shahnameh
nodes.notes: Son of Siyavash (Iran) & Farangis (Turan); unites both houses, defeats Afrasiab, and passes the crown to Kay Lohrasp.

nodes.name: Kay Lohrasp (Aurvat-aspa)
nodes.notes: Descended from Kay Apiveh -> Kay Pishin -> Kay Lohrasp; builds the fire temple at Balkh.

nodes.name: Kay Goshtasp (Kavi Vishtaspa)
nodes.notes: Champions Prophet Zarathustra's religion; father of hero Esfandiyar and brother Zarir.

nodes.name: Esfandiyar (Spento-data)
nodes.role: Son of Kay Goshtasp / Father of Bahman
nodes.notes: Bronze-bodied champion of Zoroastrianism slain by Rostam's tamarisk arrow; father of Kay Bahman.

nodes.name: Kay Bahman → Queen Homai → Darab → Dara
nodes.role: Bridge to Historical Artaxerxes & Darius III
nodes.notes: Kay Bahman (equated in Persian lore with Artaxerxes Longimanus) -> Queen Homai -> Darab -> Dara (Darius III, rival of Alexander!).

nodes.name: Spitama → Haechataspa → Pourushaspa & Dughdova
nodes.notes: Bundahishn traces Spitama (descended from Manuchehr) -> Haechataspa -> Pourushaspa, who marries Dughdova to birth Zarathustra.

nodes.name: Prophet Zarathustra (Zoroaster) & Hvovi
nodes.notes: Author of the Gathas; weds Hvovi (of the Hvova clan, kin of Frashaoshtra & Jamaspa) and fathers 3 sons and 3 daughters.

nodes.name: Isatvastra (son of Zarathustra)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Zarathustra; head of the priestly estate (Athornan).

nodes.name: Urvatatnara (son of Zarathustra)
nodes.notes: Son of Zarathustra; head of the pastoral/agricultural estate.

nodes.name: Hvarechithra (son of Zarathustra)
nodes.notes: Son of Zarathustra; head of the warrior estate.

nodes.name: Freni (dau. of Zarathustra)
nodes.notes: 1st daughter of Zarathustra.

nodes.name: Thriti (dau. of Zarathustra)
nodes.notes: 2nd daughter of Zarathustra.

nodes.name: Pouruchista (+ Jamaspa)
nodes.notes: Youngest daughter of Zarathustra celebrated in Gatha Yasna 53; marries sage Jamaspa (counselor of King Vishtaspa).

nodes.name: Deioces → Phraortes (Early Medes)
nodes.role: Founders of the Median Kingdom (Biblical Madai)
nodes.notes: Deioces (Dayukku) unifies the Median tribes at Ecbatana; followed by his son Phraortes.

nodes.name: Cyaxares (Uvakhshatra) → Astyages
nodes.role: Conquerors of Nineveh / Kings of Media
nodes.notes: Cyaxares destroys Nineveh (612 BCE) in alliance with Babylon; his son Astyages fathers Princess Mandane (mother of Cyrus the Great!).

nodes.name: Mandane (Median Princess)
nodes.role: Daughter of Astyages / Mother of Cyrus the Great
nodes.notes: Unites the Median (Madai) and Persian/Elamite (Anshan) royal houses!

nodes.name: Achaemenes (Hakhamanish) → Teispes
nodes.role: Founders of Achaemenid Dynasty (Anshan in Elam)
nodes.notes: Achaemenes -> Teispes (Chishpish), who divides his kingdom between Cyrus I (Anshan/Elam) and Ariaramnes (Persia).

nodes.name: Cyrus I → Cambyses I (Kings of Anshan)
nodes.role: Kings of Anshan (Elam) / Father of Cyrus the Great
nodes.notes: Cambyses I marries Median princess Mandane and fathers Cyrus the Great.

nodes.name: Cyrus the Great (Koresh)
nodes.role: Founder of Persian Empire / Liberator of Judah
nodes.notes: Son of Cambyses I (Anshan/Elam) & Mandane (Media/Madai). Conquers Babylon (539 BCE) and decrees the return of Judean exiles to rebuild Jerusalem! Father of Cambyses II, Bardiya, and Atossa.

nodes.name: Cambyses II, Bardiya & Queen Atossa
nodes.notes: Cambyses II conquers Egypt (525 BCE); Queen Atossa marries Darius I and becomes mother of Xerxes I (Ahasuerus)!

nodes.name: Ariaramnes → Arsames → Hystaspes (Vishtaspa)
nodes.notes: Line from Teispes to Hystaspes, father of Darius I.

nodes.name: Darius I the Great (Darayavahush)
nodes.notes: Son of Hystaspes; marries Cyrus's daughter Atossa, uniting both Achaemenid lines, and confirms Cyrus's decree to complete the Second Temple in Jerusalem.

nodes.name: Xerxes I (Ahasuerus of Book of Esther)
nodes.notes: Son of Darius I & Atossa; widely identified with King Ahasuerus (Achashverosh) in the Book of Esther!

nodes.name: Artaxerxes I → Darius III
nodes.role: Patron of Ezra & Nehemiah → Final Achaemenid
nodes.notes: Son of Xerxes I; commissions Ezra and Nehemiah to rebuild Jerusalem; dynasty continues down to Darius III (Shahnameh's Dara).

nodes.name: Dyaus Pitr (Sky Father) & Prithvi (Earth Mother)
nodes.role: Proto-Indo-European Sky Father (Exact Cognate of Greek Zeus!)
nodes.notes: Vedic Sky-Father Dyaus Pitr is the EXACT linguistic cognate of Greek Zeus Pater and Roman Jupiter! Parents of Ushas (Dawn) and Indra in early Rigvedic hymns.

nodes.name: Brahma → Svayambhuva Manu & Shatarupa
nodes.role: Vedic Primordial Progenitors & Origin of Saptarishis
nodes.notes: Brahma manifests Svayambhuva Manu and Shatarupa as the primordial human couple, and mind-borns the Saptarishis (Seven Great Sages: Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Vashishta) plus Bhrigu and Daksha.

nodes.name: Priyavrata → Nabhi → Rishabhanatha (1st Jain Tirthankara) → Bharata
nodes.era: Satya Yuga (Bhagavata Purana V / Jain Tradition)
nodes.role: Eldest Son of Svayambhuva Manu & Jain Progenitor
nodes.notes: Priyavrata divides Earth into seven continents (Dvipas); his descendant Rishabhanatha (Adinatha) is the 1st Jain Tirthankara, whose son Chakravartin Bharata is one of the traditional eponyms of Bharatavarsha (India)!

nodes.name: Uttanapada → Dhruva (Pole Star) & Daksha (+ Prasuti)
nodes.notes: Uttanapada fathers Prince Dhruva (the steadfast Pole Star); Svayambhuva Manu's daughter Prasuti marries Prajapati Daksha, father of Sati, Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kadru, and Vinata (and Devahuti + Kardama -> Sage Kapila!).

nodes.name: Vashishta (→ Parashara), Pulastya (→ Ravana) & Bhrigu (→ Shukracharya)
nodes.notes: Vashishta -> Shakti -> Parashara (father of Vyasa!); Pulastya -> Vishrava -> Kubera & Ravana (King of Lanka!); Bhrigu -> Shukracharya / Kavi Ushanas (father of Devayani, exact cognate of Iranian Kavi Usan!) & Jamadagni -> Parashurama!

nodes.name: Marichi → Kashyapa (+ Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kadru, Vinata)
nodes.role: Universal Prajapati Sage (Father of Adityas, Daityas & Nagas)
nodes.notes: Through Daksha's daughters, Kashyapa fathers the 12 Adityas (Vivasvan/Surya, Indra, Varuna, Mitra [= Avestan Mithra!], Vishnu-Vamana via Aditi), Daityas (Hiranyakashipu -> Prahlada -> Mahabali via Diti), Danavas (Danu), Nagas (Kadru), and Garuda (Vinata).

nodes.name: Hiranyakashipu → Prahlada → Virochana → King Mahabali
nodes.notes: Grandson of Kashyapa & Diti; devotee Prahlada leads to Emperor Mahabali (celebrated annually in Kerala's Onam festival).

nodes.name: Vivasvan (Surya — Solar Progenitor)
nodes.notes: Son of Kashyapa & Aditi; EXACT Proto-Indo-Iranian cognate of Avestan Vivanghant! Father of Yama (= Iranian Yima), Vaivasvata Manu (Great Flood survivor), Ashwini Kumaras, Shani, and Tapati.

nodes.name: Yama & Yami (Twin First Mortals)
nodes.role: Lord of Dharma & Exact Cognate of Avestan Yima
nodes.notes: Son of Vivasvan; exact linguistic and genealogical twin of Iranian Yima (Jamshid) son of Vivanghant.

nodes.name: Aptya → Trita Aptya & Kavi Ushanas (Shukracharya)
nodes.role: Exact Proto-Indo-Iranian Cognates of Athwya/Thraetaona & Kavi Usan
nodes.notes: Vedic dragon-slayer Trita son of Aptya is the exact cognate of Avestan Thraetaona (Fereydun) son of Athwya (Abtin), while sage Kavi Ushanas (Shukracharya, father of Yayati's wife Devayani!) is the exact cognate of Iranian King Kavi Usan (Kay Kavus)!

nodes.name: Vaivasvata Manu (Shraddhadeva — 7th Manu)
nodes.role: Vedic Great Flood Survivor (Saved by Matsya)
nodes.notes: Warned by Matsya the Fish (avatar of Vishnu), builds a vessel moored to the Himalayas to survive the universal Deluge. Father of 10 children (Ikshvaku, Ila, Nabhaga, Sharyati, etc.) — universal ancestor of humanity (Manava)!

nodes.name: Nabhaga (→ Ambarisha), Sharyati (→ Sukanya), Karusha & 5 Brothers
nodes.notes: Alongside Ikshvaku and Ila, Vaivasvata Manu fathered Nabhaga (ancestor of devotee King Ambarisha), Sharyati (father of Sukanya who married sage Chyavana, founder of Anarta/Gujarat), Dhrishta, Narishyanta, Pranshu, Dishta, Karusha, and Prishadhra.

nodes.name: Ikshvaku (Okkaka — Founder of Solar Dynasty)
nodes.role: Eldest Son of Vaivasvata Manu / Ancestor of Rama & Buddha
nodes.notes: First King of Kosala/Ayodhya; fathers 100 sons including Vikukshi (main Solar line), Nimi (Kings of Videha/Janaka!), and Dandaka. Buddhist Pali texts call him King Okkaka, ancestor of the Shakya clan!

nodes.name: Nimi → Mithi → King Janaka of Videha (Father of Sita!)
nodes.notes: Son of Ikshvaku; founds the Videha dynasty of Mithila culminating in sage-king Janaka, father of Sita (wife of Rama)!

nodes.name: Vikukshi → Kakutstha → Mandhata → Trishanku → King Harishchandra
nodes.notes: Celebrated Solar monarchs bridging Ikshvaku to Sagara; Harishchandra sacrificed kingdom and family rather than break a single vow of truth.

nodes.name: King Sagara → Anshuman → Dilipa I → Bhagiratha (River Ganga)
nodes.role: Bringer of the Sacred River Ganga to Earth
nodes.notes: Sagara's 60,000 sons dug the ocean basin (Sagara); his great-great-grandson Bhagiratha performed austerity to bring the River Ganga down from Heaven to redeem them!

nodes.name: Dilipa II → Emperor Raghu → Aja → King Dasharatha
nodes.role: Eponym of Raghuvamsha & Father of Rama
nodes.notes: Emperor Raghu gave Rama's clan its name (Raghava); his grandson Dasharatha (+ Kausalya, Kaikeyi, Sumitra) fathered Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana, and Shatrughna.

nodes.name: Rama (+ Sita), Bharata, Lakshmana & Shatrughna
nodes.notes: Prince Rama (7th Avatar of Vishnu) marries Sita of Videha and defeats Ravana of Lanka. His brother Bharata's sons Taksha & Pushkala found Taxila (Takshashila) and Pushkalavati in Gandhara!

nodes.name: Lava (Lahore) & Kusha (Kushavati) → Brihadbala
nodes.notes: Traditional founders of Lavapuri (Lahore) and Kushavati; Kusha's line continues down to King Brihadbala (who fought in the Mahabharata war) and the Ikshvaku kings of Kosala (Prasenajit, contemporary of the Buddha!).

nodes.name: Shakya Clan (Okkaka) → King Shuddhodana (+ Maya) → Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha)
nodes.notes: Buddhist chronicles trace the Shakya clan directly to King Okkaka (= Ikshvaku of the Solar Dynasty)! Siddhartha Gautama (son of Shuddhodana & Maya; father of Rahula via Yasodhara) sparks a pan-Asian movement reaching China, Korea, and Japan!

nodes.name: Atri → Soma (Chandra) → Budha + Ila (Child of Manu)
nodes.role: Union of Rishi Atri's Lunar Line & Vaivasvata Manu's Bloodline
nodes.notes: Sage Atri births Soma (Moon); Soma's son Budha marries Ila (child of Vaivasvata Manu), uniting the Solar and Lunar lineages in Pururavas!

nodes.name: Pururavas (+ Urvashi) → Ayu & Amavasu (→ Vishvamitra)
nodes.role: First Lunar Emperor & Ancestor of Vishvamitra / Dhanvantari
nodes.notes: Pururavas & celestial nymph Urvashi father Ayu (leading via Nahusha to Yayati, and via Kshatravriddha to Dhanvantari [Ayurveda] & Kings of Kashi!) and Amavasu (leading via Gadhi to Sage Vishvamitra!).

nodes.name: Nahusha → Emperor Yayati (+ Devayani & Sharmishtha)
nodes.era: Early Vedic Horizon (Father of the 5 Peoples)
nodes.notes: Son of Nahusha; marries Devayani (daughter of Shukracharya / Kavi Ushanas!) and Sharmishtha (Asura princess), fathering the 5 great Vedic tribes: Yadu, Turvasu, Druhyu, Anu, and Puru!

nodes.name: 1. Yadu (Progenitor of Yadavas & Haihayas)
nodes.notes: Eldest son of Yayati & Devayani; progenitor of the Haihayas (Kartavirya Arjuna) and Vrishni/Yadava clan of Mathura & Dvaraka (Krishna, Balarama & Kunti!).

nodes.name: 2. Turvasu (Southern / Pandya-Chola-Chera Line)
nodes.notes: Son of Yayati & Devayani; Puranas (Matsya/Harivamsha) trace the southern Tamil kingdoms (Pandya, Chola, Chera/Kerala) to Turvasu's line!

nodes.name: 3. Druhyu → Gandhara → Prachetas (NW & Trans-Indus Tribes)
nodes.notes: Son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; ancestor of King Gandhara (eponym of Gandhara / NW Pakistan-Afghanistan) and Prachetas, whose 100 sons migrate north/west across the Indus into Central Asia (Mleccha kingdoms) in Puranic ethnography!

nodes.name: 4. Anu → Ushinara (King Shibi) & Titikshu (Anga, Vanga, Kalinga)
nodes.notes: Son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; splits into Ushinara (self-sacrificing King Shibi & Madra/Kekaya in Punjab) and Titikshu -> King Bali -> 5 Eastern Kingdoms (Anga, Vanga [Bengal], Kalinga [Odisha], Pundra, Suhma)!

nodes.name: 5. Puru (Pauravas — Inheritor of Central Realm)
nodes.notes: Youngest son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; trades his youth to restore his father's vigor and inherits the central throne leading to Bharata, Kuru, and the Mahabharata!

nodes.name: Sahasrajit (→ Kartavirya Arjuna) & Kroshtu → Satvata → Vrishni → Shurasena
nodes.notes: Sahasrajit -> Haihaya -> thousand-armed Emperor Kartavirya Arjuna; Kroshtu -> Satvata -> Andhaka & Vrishni -> Shurasena (grandfather of Krishna and the Pandavas!).

nodes.name: Vasudeva (+ Devaki & Rohini) & Sister Kunti (Pritha)
nodes.role: Parents of Krishna/Balarama & Mother of the Pandavas
nodes.notes: Children of Shurasena: Vasudeva fathers Krishna, Balarama, and Subhadra; his sister Kunti marries Kuru prince Pandu, making Krishna and the Pandavas first cousins!

nodes.name: Krishna (+ Rukmini), Balarama & Subhadra → Pradyumna → Vajra
nodes.role: Speaker of the Bhagavad Gita & Lords of Dvaraka
nodes.notes: Krishna (8th Avatar of Vishnu) & Balarama rule Dvaraka; Krishna's sister Subhadra marries Pandava Arjuna (birthing Abhimanyu!), while Krishna's son Pradyumna -> Aniruddha -> Vajra survives the fall of Dvaraka to rule Indraprastha!

nodes.name: Dushyanta (+ Shakuntala) → Emperor Bharata (Eponym of India!)
nodes.notes: King Dushyanta (descendant of Puru) marries Shakuntala (daughter of Sage Vishvamitra & Menaka), birthing Emperor Bharata — who gives India its classical name Bharatavarsha!

nodes.name: Hasti (Hastinapura) → Ajamidha (→ Panchala/Drupada) → King Kuru
nodes.notes: Hasti founds Hastinapura; Ajamidha branches into Panchala (King Drupada -> Draupadi & Dhrishtadyumna) and Samvarana (+ Tapati, daughter of Surya!) -> King Kuru (eponym of Kurukshetra & Kauravas)!

nodes.name: King Shantanu (+ Ganga → Bhishma; + Satyavati) & Sage Vyasa
nodes.role: Patriarchs of Hastinapura & Compiler of the Vedas
nodes.notes: Shantanu + Goddess Ganga -> Bhishma (vow of celibacy); Shantanu + Satyavati -> Vichitravirya. Satyavati's elder son Sage Vyasa (by Rishi Parashara, great-grandson of Vashishta!) compiles the 4 Vedas & Mahabharata and sires Dhritarashtra, Pandu, and Vidura!

nodes.name: Dhritarashtra (+ Gandhari) → Duryodhana, Dushasana & 100 Kauravas
nodes.notes: Blind King Dhritarashtra marries Princess Gandhari of Gandhara (sister of Shakuni — uniting Kuru and NW Gandhara!), fathering Duryodhana, 99 brothers, and daughter Duhshala.

nodes.name: Pandu (+ Kunti & Madri) → Karna & ALL 5 Pandavas (+ Draupadi)
nodes.notes: Kunti bears Karna (by Surya) and Yudhishthira, Bhima (-> Ghatotkacha), & Arjuna; Madri (princess of Madra!) bears twins Nakula & Sahadeva. All 5 Pandavas wed Draupadi (Princess of Panchala); Arjuna also weds Krishna's sister Subhadra -> Abhimanyu!

nodes.name: Abhimanyu (+ Uttara) → King Parikshit → King Janamejaya
nodes.era: Dawn of Kali Yuga (Vishnu Purana IV.21)
nodes.notes: Abhimanyu (son of Arjuna & Subhadra, uniting Kurus & Yadavas!) fathers Parikshit (saved in the womb by Krishna); at his son Janamejaya's serpent sacrifice, Vaishampayana first recites the Mahabharata!

nodes.name: Magadha (Jarasandha → Bimbisara) → Chandragupta Maurya → Emperor Ashoka
nodes.role: Unifier of India & Global Inscription Bridge (Greece, Egypt & Asia!)
nodes.notes: Chandragupta Maurya (mentored by Chanakya) defeats Alexander's successor Seleucus I (305 BCE) and seals a marriage alliance with the Seleucid house! His grandson Emperor Ashoka the Great explicitly names Ptolemy II of Egypt, Antiochus II of Syria, and Macedon in Rock Edict XIII while sending Buddhist missions across Asia!

nodes.name: Alara of Kush (Founder of Napatan Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Unified Upper Nubia around Napata (Jebel Barkal); revered by all later Kushite pharaohs as their founding ancestor.

nodes.name: Kashta & Queen Pebatjma
nodes.role: Brother of Alara / First Kushite King in Upper Egypt
nodes.notes: Extended Kushite rule into Upper Egypt and installed his daughter Amenirdis I as God's Wife of Amun at Thebes; father of Piye and Shabaka.

nodes.name: Piye (Piankhi) & Shabaka (25th Dynasty Pharaohs)
nodes.role: Kushite Conquerors & Restorers of Unified Egypt
nodes.notes: Piye conquered all of Egypt from Nubia to the Delta; his brother Shabaka preserved the ancient Memphite Theology of Ptah on the Shabaka Stone!

nodes.name: Shebitku & Taharqa (Biblical Tirhakah, King of Cush!)
nodes.role: Greatest 25th Dynasty Pharaoh — Named in 2 Kings 19:9
nodes.notes: Son of Piye; explicitly named in the Bible as 'Tirhakah, King of Cush' who marched to relieve King Hezekiah's Jerusalem from Assyrian Emperor Sennacherib (701 BCE)!

nodes.name: Tantamani → Aspelta → Ergamenes (Meroe)
nodes.role: Last Kushite Pharaoh of Egypt → Founders of Meroe
nodes.notes: Tantamani (son of Shabaka) was the last 25th Dynasty king in Egypt; Aspelta shifted the royal capital south to Meroe (creating the Meroitic script and pyramid fields!).

nodes.name: Queen Shanakdakhete → Amanirenas → Amanitore (Kandakes)
nodes.notes: Meroe was ruled by powerful Candaces (Kandakes): Amanirenas battled Roman Augustus's legions (capturing his bronze head at Meroe!), and Queen Amanitore corresponds to 'Candace, Queen of the Ethiopians' in Acts 8:27!

nodes.name: King Kikanos of Cush (+ Queen Adoniah) → Menakrus
nodes.role: Cushite Royal House in Moses's 40-Year Reign
nodes.notes: Book of Jasher 72-76 recounts Moses aiding King Kikanos against the rebel Balaam, marrying Queen Adoniah, and ruling Cush for 40 years before turning the kingdom over to Kikanos's son Menakrus!

nodes.name: Ityopis (Ethiopic, son of Cush) → Aksumawi
nodes.role: Traditional Eponym of Ethiopia & Founder of Aksum
nodes.notes: Traditional Ethiopian royal chronicles trace Ethiopia directly from Ham -> Cush -> Ityopis (eponym of Ethiopia) -> Aksumawi (founder of Aksum) -> Malakya Aksum!

nodes.name: Arwe (Serpent King) → Angabo → Gedur → Tawasya
nodes.role: Slayer of Arwe & Ancestors of Queen Makeda
nodes.notes: Angabo slays the tyrant serpent-king Arwe and founds the Agazian dynasty of Aksum leading directly to Queen Makeda!

nodes.name: Queen Makeda (Queen of Sheba / Saba / Bilqis)
nodes.era: c. 10th c. BCE trad. (1 Kings 10 / Kebra Nagast)
nodes.role: Sovereign of Aksum & Sheba / Mother of Menelik I
nodes.notes: Journeys from Aksum/Sheba to Jerusalem to test King Solomon's wisdom; bears Menelik I, uniting the lineages of Judah/Israel, Saba/Arabia, and Cush/Ethiopia!

nodes.name: Zagduru → Bazen → Emperor Ezana & King Kaleb of Aksum
nodes.role: First Christian Emperor of Aksum (c. 330 CE)
nodes.notes: King Bazen reigned at the turn of the 1st century CE; Emperor Ezana converted Aksum to Christianity (c. 330 CE) and conquered Meroe; King Kaleb (Ella Atsbeha) campaigned in Himyar/Yemen!

nodes.name: Mara Takla Haymanot → Emperor Gebre Mesqel Lalibela (Zagwe)
nodes.role: Carver of Rock-Hewn Churches (Trad. Line of Moses & Zipporah)
nodes.notes: Ethiopian Zagwe chronicles trace the Zagwe kings to a daughter of the Aksumite line AND traditionally claim descent from Moses & Zipporah! Lalibela carved the 11 monolithic churches of 'New Jerusalem'.

nodes.name: Yekuno Amlak → Zara Yaqob → Menelik II → Haile Selassie I
nodes.notes: Yekuno Amlak restored the Solomonic Dynasty in 1270 CE; continued through Zara Yaqob, Menelik II (victor at Adwa), down to Haile Selassie I (225th ruler from Menelik I!).

nodes.name: Olodumare → Obatala & Oduduwa (Progenitor of the Yoruba)
nodes.role: Founding Ancestor of Yoruba & Benin Kingdoms
sources: Samuel Johnson History of the Yorubas
nodes.notes: In indigenous Ifa cosmology, Olodumare sends Obatala and Oduduwa to establish Ile-Ife (cradle of humanity). A later 19th-c. syncretic oral chronicle (Samuel Johnson) compares Oduduwa's eastern migration to 'Lamurudu' (Nimrod) from the East!

nodes.name: Okanbi (Son of Oduduwa)
nodes.role: Father of the 7 Crowned Yoruba Monarchs
nodes.notes: Only son of Oduduwa in core Ife genealogy; father of 7 royal children who founded the major Yoruba kingdoms and the Benin dynasty.

nodes.name: Bayajidda (Abuyazidu of Baghdad) + Queen Daurama → Bawo
nodes.role: Progenitor of the 7 Hausa Bakwai Kingdoms
nodes.notes: Prince Bayajidda journeys from Baghdad across Bornu to Daura (Nigeria), slays the well-serpent Sarki, weds Queen Magajiya Daurama, and sires Bawo — father of the 7 Hausa Bakwai states (Daura, Kano, Katsina, Zaria, Gobir, Rano, Biram)!

nodes.name: Bilali Bounama → Naré Maghann → Sundiata Keita → Mansa Musa
nodes.role: Founder of the Mali Empire (Lion King of Manden)
nodes.notes: Mande royal griots trace the Keita dynasty from Bilali Bounama (traditionally linked to Bilal ibn Rabah, Ethiopian companion of Muhammad!) to Sundiata Keita (founder of Mali, 1235 CE) and Mansa Musa!

nodes.name: Mazigh → Baranis & Botr → Queen Dihya (Imazighen / Berbers)
nodes.role: Eponymous Ancestor of the Amazigh (Berber) Peoples
nodes.notes: Imazighen ('Free People', attested in Herodotus as Maxyes and Egyptian inscriptions as Meshwesh!). Medieval North African genealogists (Ibn Khaldun) linked Mazigh to Ham's sons Phut/Canaan, branching into the Baranis & Botr confederations and heroic Queen Dihya (al-Kahina).

nodes.name: Kintu & Nambi (Buganda) / Gikuyu & Mumbi (Kikuyu)
nodes.role: First Human Couples of Great Lakes & East Africa
nodes.notes: Kintu & Nambi (daughter of sky-king Ggulu) are the primeval progenitors of Buganda's Kabaka kings; Gikuyu & Mumbi (created near Mt. Kenya by Ngai) are the progenitors of the nine Kikuyu clans (Nyumba ya Mumbi).

nodes.name: Oranmiyan (Oranyan — Founder of Oyo & Benin Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Youngest and mightiest grandson of Oduduwa; founded the Oyo Empire (father of Ajaka & Shango!) and fathered Eweka I, founder of the Oba Dynasty of Benin!

nodes.name: Eweka I (First Oba of Benin, son of Oranmiyan)
nodes.notes: Son of Oranmiyan & Princess Erinmwinde of Benin; founder of the historic Oba Dynasty of the Kingdom of Benin.

nodes.name: Olowu of Owu
nodes.notes: 1st crowned grandchild of Oduduwa (son of Okanbi's eldest daughter).

nodes.name: Alaketu of Ketu
nodes.notes: Founder of the Yoruba kingdom of Ketu (Benin Republic/Nigeria).

nodes.name: Onisabe of Sabe
nodes.notes: Founder of the kingdom of Sabe.

nodes.name: Olupopo of Popo
nodes.notes: Founder of the Popo kingdom.

nodes.name: Orangun of Ila
nodes.notes: Founder of the kingdom of Ila-Orangun.

nodes.name: Bagauda (Kano) & Daura
nodes.notes: Founding Hausa Bakwai kingdoms descended from Bawo.

nodes.name: Kumayau (Katsina) & Gunguma (Zaria/Zazzau)
nodes.notes: Founding Hausa Bakwai kingdoms (Zaria later famed for Warrior Queen Amina!).

nodes.name: Duma (Gobir), Zamna Kogi (Rano) & Biram
nodes.notes: Founding Hausa Bakwai kingdoms.

nodes.name: Chaos → Gaia (Earth) & Uranus (Sky)
nodes.notes: Out of Chaos emerges Gaia (Earth), who births Uranus (Starry Sky); their union generates the 12 Titans.

nodes.name: Cronus (Kronos) & Rhea
nodes.notes: Youngest Titan who overthrows Uranus; parents of the six elder Olympians (Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Hestia, Hades). In Phoenician Sanchuniathon, El is equated with Kronos!

nodes.name: Iapetus (Titan) & Clymene / Asia
nodes.notes: Titan father of Atlas, Prometheus, Epimetheus, and Menoetius — frequently compared by classical and biblical scholars to Noah's son Japheth (Hebrew Yefet <-> Greek Iapetos)!

nodes.name: Oceanus & Tethys / Hyperion & Coeus
nodes.notes: Oceanus & Tethys sire the 3,000 River Gods (including Inachus of Argos and Nile!) and Oceanids; Hyperion sires Helios (Sun) & Selene; Coeus sires Leto (mother of Apollo & Artemis).

nodes.name: Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Hestia & Hades
nodes.role: Elder Olympian Gods (Zeus = PIE Dyaus Pitr!)
nodes.notes: Zeus (exact Proto-Indo-European linguistic cognate of Vedic Sky-Father Dyaus Pitr & Roman Jupiter!) and Poseidon become the divine progenitors of Greece's heroic royal houses.

nodes.name: Atlas (Titan) → Pleiades (Electra & Maia)
nodes.role: Bearer of the Heavens / Ancestor of Troy & Hermes
nodes.notes: Son of Iapetus; father of the Seven Pleiades including Electra (mother of Dardanus, founder of Troy!) and Maia (mother of Hermes).

nodes.name: Prometheus & Epimetheus (+ Pandora)
nodes.notes: Sons of Iapetus. Prometheus molds mortals from clay and water and brings fire from heaven; Epimetheus weds Pandora (first mortal woman) -> Pyrrha!

nodes.name: Deucalion & Pyrrha (Greek Great Flood Survivors)
nodes.notes: Deucalion (son of Prometheus) and Pyrrha (daughter of Epimetheus & Pandora) survive Zeus's world-destroying Flood in a wooden chest/ark (larnax) landing on Mt. Parnassus!

nodes.name: Hellen & Orseis (Eponym of the Greeks / Hellenes)
nodes.role: Progenitor of the Greek Peoples (3 Sons)
nodes.notes: Son of Deucalion & Pyrrha; divides the Greek world among his three sons Dorus, Xuthus, and Aeolus — the Greek 'Table of Nations'!

nodes.name: Dorus (Dorians — Sparta & Peloponnese)
nodes.notes: Eponymous ancestor of the Dorians.

nodes.name: Xuthus & Creusa
nodes.notes: Father of Ion (Ionians) and Achaeus (Achaeans).

nodes.name: Ion (Ionians / Iawones = Biblical Javan!)
nodes.role: Eponym of the Ionians (Exact Cognate of Javan)
nodes.notes: Son of Xuthus (or Apollo) & Creusa; eponym of the Ionians (Archaic Greek Iawones) — EXACT linguistic cognate of Biblical Javan (Yawan, son of Japheth, Gen 10:2)!

nodes.name: Achaeus (Achaeans)
nodes.notes: Eponymous ancestor of the Achaeans (Homer's Greeks).

nodes.name: Aeolus (Aeolians)
nodes.notes: Eponym of the Aeolians; father of Sisyphus, Cretheus, Athamas, Salmoneus, Deion, Magnes, and Perieres.

nodes.name: Sisyphus (King of Corinth → Bellerophon)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; founder of Corinth, grandfather of Pegasus-rider Bellerophon.

nodes.name: Cretheus → Aeson → Jason (Argonauts)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; founder of Iolcus, grandfather of Jason (leader of the Argonauts to Colchis on the Black Sea!).

nodes.name: Salmoneus → Tyro → Pelias & Neleus (→ Nestor)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; ancestor of Neleus and wise King Nestor of Pylos.

nodes.name: Athamas → Phrixus & Helle (Golden Fleece)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; father of Phrixus & Helle (eponym of the Hellespont).

nodes.name: Inachus (Argos) → Phoroneus & Io
nodes.role: First King of Argos & Ancestress of Egypt/Phoenicia/Greece
nodes.notes: Inachus (son of Oceanus) fathers Phoroneus (first mortal king of Argos) and Io, who wanders across the Bosporus into Egypt!

nodes.name: Epaphus (King of Egypt) & Queen Memphis
nodes.role: Son of Zeus & Io / Identified with Egyptian Apis
nodes.notes: Born to Io beside the Nile; becomes King of Egypt, marries Memphis (eponym of Egypt's capital!), and fathers Libya.

nodes.name: Libya (Eponym of North Africa)
nodes.role: Mother of Belus & Agenor (Uniting Africa, Egypt, Phoenicia & Greece!)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Epaphus & Memphis; by Poseidon bears twin sons Belus (Egypt/Babylon/Aethiopia) and Agenor (Tyre/Phoenicia)!

nodes.name: Agenor (King of Tyre / Phoenicia) & Telephassa
nodes.role: Twin Son of Libya & Poseidon / Father of Europa & Cadmus
nodes.notes: Moves from Egypt to Phoenicia (Tyre/Sidon) and fathers Europa, Cadmus, Phoenix, Cilix, and Thasus!

nodes.name: Europa → King Minos of Crete, Rhadamanthus & Sarpedon
nodes.role: Phoenician Princess → Minoan Royal House (Ariadne & Phaedra)
nodes.notes: Carried from Phoenicia to Crete (Biblical Caphtorim!) by Zeus; bears King Minos (lawgiver of Knossos; father of Ariadne & Phaedra), Rhadamanthus, and Sarpedon.

nodes.name: Cadmus (Founder of Thebes) & Harmonia
nodes.role: Bringer of the Phoenician Alphabet to Greece
nodes.notes: Son of Agenor of Tyre; settles in Boeotia, founds Thebes, and introduces the 'Phoenician letters' (alphabet!) to Greece! Fathers Semele (-> Dionysus), Ino, Autonoe, Agave, and Polydorus.

nodes.name: Semele (→ Dionysus) & Polydorus → Laius → Oedipus → Antigone
nodes.notes: Cadmus's daughter Semele bears Dionysus; his son Polydorus leads via Labdacus -> Laius to Oedipus -> Antigone, Eteocles, and Polynices.

nodes.name: Phoenix (Phoenicians) & Cilix (Cilicia)
nodes.notes: Brothers of Cadmus and Europa who settle Phoenicia and Cilicia (SE Anatolia).

nodes.name: Belus (King of Egypt — Ba'al)
nodes.role: Twin Son of Libya & Poseidon / Father of Aegyptus, Danaus & Cepheus
nodes.notes: Reigns in Egypt (name reflects Semitic Ba'al/Bel); fathers Aegyptus, Danaus, Cepheus (King of Aethiopia), and Phineus.

nodes.name: Aegyptus (50 Sons) & Danaus (50 Danaids → Argos)
nodes.role: Eponym of Egypt & Founder of Danaan Argos
nodes.notes: Aegyptus gives his name to Egypt; his twin brother Danaus flees Egypt with his 50 daughters (Danaids) to become King of Argos in Greece (Homer's 'Danaans'!). Daughter Hypermnestra marries Aegyptus's son Lynceus!

nodes.name: Cepheus (King of Aethiopia) & Cassiopeia → Andromeda
nodes.notes: Brother of Danaus & Aegyptus; rules Aethiopia/Joppa coast. Daughter Andromeda is rescued from the sea monster Cetus by Perseus!

nodes.name: Lynceus → Abas → Acrisius → Danaë → Perseus
nodes.role: Slayer of Medusa / Husband of Andromeda
nodes.notes: Descendant of Egyptian Danaus & Aegyptus; slays Medusa, rescues and marries Princess Andromeda of Aethiopia, founds Mycenae, and fathers Perses (mythic eponym of Persia!) and the ancestors of Heracles!

nodes.name: Perses (Son of Perseus & Andromeda)
nodes.role: Greek Mythic Eponym of the Persians!
nodes.notes: Herodotus (VII.61) explicitly records the ancient tradition that the Persians took their name from Perses, son of Perseus and Andromeda — a classic Greek-Iranian genealogical bridge!

nodes.name: Alcaeus / Electryon → Alcmene → Heracles (Hercules)
nodes.role: Greatest Greek Hero / Ancestor of Sparta & Macedon
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Perseus & Andromeda (via Alcmene & Zeus). His sons (Heraclidae: Hyllus, Temenus) become the royal houses of Sparta and Macedon — and 1 Maccabees 12:21 records Sparta claiming kinship with Abraham!

nodes.name: Hyllus → Kings of Sparta (Areus I) & Argead Macedon (Philip II)
nodes.notes: Heraclidae conquer the Peloponnese (Sparta: Leonidas, King Areus I who wrote to Jerusalem's High Priest claiming descent from Abraham!) and Temenus's line founds Macedon (Perdiccas I -> Philip II).

nodes.name: Alexander the Great (Macedon → Persia, Egypt & India)
nodes.role: Conqueror Uniting Greece, Egypt, Mesopotamia, Persia & NW India
nodes.notes: Son of Philip II (Heraclid) and Olympias (claiming descent from Achilles!). Conquers Darius III of Persia, is crowned Pharaoh in Egypt, and marches to the Indus — even woven into the Persian Shahnameh as 'Eskandar' (half-brother of Dara)!

nodes.name: Tantalus (Lydia) → Pelops → Atreus & Thyestes
nodes.notes: Tantalus of Anatolia/Lydia fathers Pelops (eponym of the Peloponnese!), who fathers Atreus and Thyestes.

nodes.name: Agamemnon (→ Orestes) & Menelaus (+ Helen of Sparta)
nodes.role: Kings of Mycenae & Sparta (Sons of Atreus)
nodes.notes: Agamemnon leads the Achaeans against Troy (father of Orestes, Electra, Iphigenia); Menelaus weds Helen (daughter of Zeus & Leda, sister of Castor, Pollux & Clytemnestra).

nodes.name: Peleus → Achilles & Laertes → Odysseus (→ Telemachus)
nodes.notes: Achilles (son of Peleus & Thetis, grandson of Aeacus; father of Neoptolemus — claimed ancestor of Alexander's mother Olympias!) and Odysseus (King of Ithaca, father of Telemachus).

nodes.name: Dardanus (son of Zeus & Electra) → Erichthonius → Tros
nodes.notes: Dardanus (son of Zeus & Atlas's daughter Electra) founds Dardania near the Hellespont; grandson Tros gives his name to Troy and fathers Ilus, Assaracus, and Ganymede!

nodes.name: Ilus → Laomedon → King Priam → Hector, Paris & Cassandra
nodes.notes: Senior branch of Troy: Ilus -> Laomedon -> King Priam & Queen Hecuba, parents of Hector, Paris (Alexander), Cassandra, Helenus, and Creusa (first wife of Aeneas).

nodes.name: Assaracus → Capys → Anchises → Aeneas (+ Lavinia)
nodes.era: Fall of Troy → Migration to Italy (Aeneid)
nodes.notes: Junior Trojan branch: Assaracus -> Capys -> Anchises (+ Aphrodite) -> Aeneas, who escapes burning Troy to Italy (Latium), marries Lavinia (daughter of King Latinus), and fathers Ascanius (Iulus) and Silvius!

nodes.name: Ascanius (Iulus) → Alba Longa Kings → Rhea Silvia → Romulus & Remus
nodes.notes: Ascanius (Iulus, ancestor of the Julian clan / Julius Caesar!) & Silvius found Alba Longa -> 12 Alban kings -> Numitor -> Rhea Silvia (+ Mars) -> twin founders Romulus & Remus! Directly intersects Book of Jasher's Kittim/Zepho/Janeus chronicle of early Italy!

nodes.name: Ethbaal of Tyre → Mattan I → Queen Dido (Elissa of Carthage)
nodes.role: Phoenician Founder of Carthage (Great-Niece of Jezebel!)
nodes.notes: Tyrian royal records (Menander of Ephesus, quoted by Josephus) trace King Ethbaal (Ithobaal I of Sidon/Tyre, father of Biblical Jezebel!) -> Baal-Eser II -> Mattan I -> Pygmalion & Queen Elissa (Dido), who sails from Tyre to North Africa and founds Carthage!

nodes.name: Atys of Lydia → Lydus (Lydians) & Tyrrhenus (Etruscans)
nodes.notes: Herodotus records that during an 18-year famine in Lydia (Biblical Lud, Gen 10:22!), King Atys split his people between Lydus (staying in Anatolia) and Tyrrhenus, who sailed to Italy to found the Etruscans (Tyrsenians — widely linked by scholars to Biblical Tiras, Gen 10:2)!

nodes.name: Pangu (Cosmic Creator)
nodes.notes: Emerges from the cosmic egg, separates Yin (Earth) and Yang (Heaven), and transforms his body into mountains, rivers, sun, and moon.

nodes.name: Fuxi & Nüwa (Three Sovereigns)
nodes.notes: Serpent-tailed sovereigns holding compass and square. Fuxi invents the Eight Trigrams (Bagua), fishing nets, and music; Nüwa repairs the shattered sky after Gonggong's flood and molds humanity from yellow clay. Preserved in SW Chinese Miao/Yao lore as Great Flood survivors!

nodes.name: Shaodian & Youqiao (Guoyu)
nodes.notes: Guoyu explicitly records Shaodian and Lady Youqiao as parents of BOTH Yandi (Jiang surname) and Huangdi (Ji surname) — explaining the ancestral brotherhood of 'Yan-Huang Zisun'!

nodes.name: Yandi (Flame Emperor / Shennong)
nodes.notes: Inventor of agriculture, plows, and herbal medicine; ancestor of the Jiang clan (later Jiang Ziya & the State of Qi!). Allies with Huangdi after the Battle of Banquan to defeat Chiyou.

nodes.name: Chiyou (Jiuli Tribe) & Jiang Ziya (State of Qi)
nodes.notes: Chiyou (legendary bronze-working leader of the Nine Li / Miao-Hmong ancestor!) fought Huangdi at Zhuolu; Jiang Ziya (descendant of Yandi's clan) helped King Wu found the Zhou Dynasty and became Duke of Qi.

nodes.name: Huangdi (Yellow Emperor) & Leizu
nodes.role: Universal Royal Ancestor in Sima Qian's Shiji (25 Sons)
nodes.notes: Marries Leizu (inventor of silk sericulture) and sires 25 sons bearing 14 surnames. Sima Qian systematically traces ALL Five Emperors, Xia, Shang, Zhou, Qin, Chu, Confucius, and the Xiongnu back to Huangdi!

nodes.name: Shaohao (Xuanxiao) → Jiaoji
nodes.notes: Son of Huangdi & Leizu; ancestor of Eastern Yi bird-totem clans and father of Jiaoji -> Emperor Ku.

nodes.name: Emperor Ku (Di Ku / Gaoxin)
nodes.role: Great-Grandson of Huangdi / Father of Yao, Shang & Zhou
nodes.notes: By his four consorts, Di Ku fathers Emperor Zhi, Emperor Yao (via Qingdu), Xie (founder of Shang via Jiandi), and Hou Ji (founder of Zhou via Jiang Yuan)!

nodes.name: Emperor Yao (Tang Yao → Liu Bang / Han Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Son of Di Ku & Qingdu; appoints Gun & Yu to combat the Great Flood, marries his daughters Ehuang & Nüying to Emperor Shun, and passes the throne by merit. Han Dynasty emperors (Liu Bang) claimed descent from Yao!

nodes.name: Xie (son of Di Ku & Jiandi) → Wang Hai
nodes.role: Progenitor of the Shang Royal House (Zi Clan)
nodes.notes: Conceived when Jiandi swallowed a black bird's egg; assisted Yu the Great with the Flood; leads through 14 predynastic lords (including Wang Hai) to Tang of Shang.

nodes.name: Tang of Shang (Cheng Tang) → Pan Geng
nodes.role: Founder of Shang Dynasty & Mover of Capital to Anyang
nodes.notes: Overthrew Xia tyrant Jie to found the Shang Dynasty; 19th king Pan Geng moved the capital to Yin (Anyang), where tens of thousands of oracle bones confirm Sima Qian's king list!

nodes.name: King Wu Ding & Warrior Queen Fu Hao
nodes.role: First Historically Verified Shang Monarch & Female General
nodes.notes: 21st Shang king attested in contemporary oracle bones; his consort Fu Hao served as supreme general and high priestess (her intact tomb at Anyang is one of archaeology's greatest treasures!).

nodes.name: Di Xin (King Zhou of Shang) — Final Shang King
nodes.role: Last King of Shang (Battle of Muye)
nodes.notes: Defeated by King Wu of Zhou in 1046 BCE, ending the Shang Dynasty.

nodes.name: Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) → Kong He → Confucius (Kong Qiu)
nodes.role: Shang Royal Descendant & China's Great Sage
nodes.notes: Sima Qian's Shiji Ch. 47 traces Confucius (Kong Qiu) directly back through the Dukes of Song to Weizi Qi (brother of Di Xin) -> Shang Dynasty -> Xie -> Di Ku -> Yellow Emperor!

nodes.name: Jizi (Gija — Shang Prince Migrating to Korea)
nodes.role: Shang Royal Sage & China-Korea Chronicle Bridge
nodes.notes: Uncle/kinsman of Shang king Di Xin; recorded in both Chinese (*Shiji*) and Korean (*Samguk Yusa*) chronicles as migrating east to Joseon with 5,000 followers after the fall of Shang!

nodes.name: Hou Ji (Lord Millet) → Gong Liu → Gugong Danfu
nodes.role: Minister of Agriculture & Progenitor of Zhou
nodes.notes: Son of Di Ku & Jiang Yuan; taught millet farming and founded the Ji lineage leading via Buzhu -> Gong Liu -> Gugong Danfu (whose elder sons Taibo & Zhongyong founded the State of Wu!).

nodes.name: King Wen (Ji Chang) → King Wu (Ji Fa) of Zhou
nodes.role: Founders of the Zhou Dynasty & Mandate of Heaven
nodes.notes: King Wen expanded the Yijing (Book of Changes); his son King Wu allied with Jiang Ziya to defeat Shang at Muye (1046 BCE), establishing China's longest dynasty (800 years!).

nodes.name: Duke of Zhou (Ji Dan — Founder of Lu) & King Mu of Zhou
nodes.role: Architect of Zhou Rites & Western Silk-Road Traveler
nodes.notes: Duke of Zhou (brother of King Wu) founded the State of Lu (homeland of Confucius!) and codified classical ritual; 5th king King Mu journeyed far west into Central Asia to meet Xiwangmu (Queen Mother of the West)!

nodes.name: Changyi → Emperor Zhuanxu (Gaoyang)
nodes.role: Separator of Heaven & Earth / Ancestor of Xia, Shun, Qin & Chu
nodes.notes: Grandson of Huangdi via Changyi; ordered the separation of Heaven and Earth (Jue Di Tian Tong). Progenitor of FOUR huge dynasties: Xia, Shun/Chen, Qin, and Chu!

nodes.name: Gun (Father of Yu the Great)
nodes.era: Great Flood Era (Shangshu / Shan Hai Jing)
nodes.role: Descendant of Zhuanxu Who Stole Xirang Soil
nodes.notes: Descendant of Zhuanxu tasked by Emperor Yao with halting the Great Flood; stole the heavenly self-expanding earth (Xirang) to build dikes, was executed on Feather Mountain, and from his body emerged Yu the Great!

nodes.name: Yu the Great (Da Yu) & Tushan Shi → Qi (Xia Dynasty)
nodes.role: Tamer of the Great Flood & Founder of Xia Dynasty
nodes.notes: Spent 13 years dredging channels to drain the Gun-Yu Great Flood into the sea, mapping the Nine Provinces; his son Qi established China's first hereditary dynasty (Xia)!

nodes.name: Tai Kang → Shao Kang (Xia Restoration) → King Jie & State of Yue
nodes.role: Xia Successors & Ancestors of Yue (King Goujian)
nodes.notes: Shao Kang restored the Xia Dynasty after Hou Yi's usurpation; his son Wuyu founded the southern State of Yue (later led by King Goujian); Xia ended under tyrant Jie.

nodes.name: Gusou → Emperor Shun (Youyu) & Ehuang / Nüying
nodes.notes: Descended from Zhuanxu via Qiongchan -> Jingkang -> Juwang -> Qiaoniu -> Gusou; married Yao's two daughters Ehuang & Nüying and passed the throne to Yu the Great. Ancestor of the State of Chen!

nodes.name: Nüxiu → Daye → Boyi → Feizi → Qin Shi Huang (First Emperor)
nodes.role: House of Ying (Descendants of Zhuanxu → Unified China!)
nodes.notes: Sima Qian's Shiji Ch. 5 traces the Ying clan from Zhuanxu's granddaughter Nüxiu -> Daye -> Boyi (Yu the Great's companion!) -> Feizi -> Dukes of Qin -> Ying Zheng (**Qin Shi Huang**, First Emperor of unified China, 221 BCE)!

nodes.name: Zhurong → Luzhong (Pengzu, 800 yrs!) → Jilian → State of Chu (Qu Yuan)
nodes.role: House of Mi / Southern Chu Dynasty (Descendant of Zhuanxu)
nodes.notes: Shiji Ch. 40 traces the southern Chu royal house from Zhuanxu -> Zhurong (Fire deity!) -> Wuhui -> Luzhong (father of 6 sons including 800-year longevity sage Pengzu and Jilian!) -> Xiong Yi -> poet Qu Yuan & Hegemon Xiang Yu!

nodes.name: Chunwei (Xia Prince) → Touman → Modu Chanyu (Xiongnu)
nodes.role: Sima Qian's Bridge Between Chinese Xia & Inner Asian Steppe
sources: Sima Qian Shiji Ch. 110 (Account of the Xiongnu)
nodes.notes: Sima Qian explicitly records that the Xiongnu descended from Chunwei, a prince of the Xia Dynasty who migrated to the northern steppes; unified under Touman -> Modu Chanyu (209 BCE)!

nodes.name: Turk (Oljai Khan) → Tatar & Mongol → Oghuz Khagan
nodes.role: Eponymous Ancestor of Turkic & Mongol Peoples
nodes.notes: Rashid al-Din & Abulghazi explicitly graft Turkic/Mongol ancestry onto Biblical Japheth (Yafith -> Oljai -> Alinja -> Tatar & Mongol -> Kara Khan -> Oghuz Khagan) and Iranian Turan!

nodes.name: 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz
nodes.role: Founders of the 24 Oghuz Turkic Tribes (Seljuks & Ottomans!)
nodes.notes: Oghuz's 3 elder sons (Bozok: Gün, Ay, Yildiz) and 3 younger sons (Üçok: Gök, Dağ, Deniz) each sire 4 sons = the 24 Oghuz clans (including Kayı -> Ottomans and Kınık -> Seljuks!).

nodes.name: Hwanin (Lord of Heaven) → Hwanung & Ungnyeo
sources: Samguk Yusa (1281 CE, citing lost Gogi)
nodes.notes: Hwanung descends from Heaven to Mt. Taebaek with 3,000 followers and the gods of Wind, Rain, and Clouds; weds Ungnyeo (the bear who endured 100 days of mugwort and garlic to become human).

nodes.name: Dangun Wanggeom (Founder of Gojoseon, 2333 BCE trad.) → Buru
nodes.role: Founding Ancestor of the Korean People
nodes.notes: Son of Hwanung & Ungnyeo; founded Gojoseon (Asadal) in the traditional era of Chinese Emperor Yao! Father of Prince Buru (who in Korean annals meets Yu the Great at Tushan!).

nodes.name: Hae Mosu + Yuhwa → King Dongmyeong (Jumong — Goguryeo)
nodes.notes: Born from a luminous egg to Yuhwa (daughter of River God Habaek) and heavenly prince Hae Mosu; founded the northern kingdom of Goguryeo (leading to King Yuri and King Gwanggaeto the Great!).

nodes.name: Soseono → Onjo (Founder of Baekje) → King Geunchogo
nodes.role: Founder of Baekje & Royal Bridge to Yamato Japan!
nodes.notes: Onjo (son of Jumong & Lady Soseono) founded Baekje in SW Korea; Baekje became Yamato Japan's closest ally, transmitting Chinese writing (Wani), Buddhism, and royal intermarriage (Emperor Kammu's mother descended from Baekje's King Muryeong!)!

nodes.name: Park Hyeokgeose (+ Aryeong), Seok Talhae & Kim Alji (Silla)
nodes.role: Founding Clans of Silla (Park, Seok & Kim)
nodes.notes: Park Hyeokgeose (born from a luminous egg at Najeong well) founded Silla; joined by Seok Talhae and Kim Alji (born from a golden box in Gyerim forest — ancestor of Queen Seondeok & unified Silla kings!).

nodes.name: King Suro of Gaya + Queen Heo Hwang-ok (Princess of Ayuta / India!)
nodes.role: India ↔ Korea Royal Marriage Bridge (Gimhae Kim & Heo Clans)
nodes.notes: King Suro (born from one of 6 golden eggs on Mt. Guji) married Princess Heo Hwang-ok (Suriratna), who sailed to Korea from the Kingdom of Ayuta (traditionally identified with Ayodhya, India — capital of the Solar Dynasty!) carrying a stone pagoda. Ancestors of millions of Gimhae Kim & Heo Koreans!

nodes.name: Ame-no-Minakanushi, Takamimusubi & Kamimusubi
nodes.notes: Three primordial creation deities appearing at the dawn of Heaven and Earth; Takamimusubi is the maternal grandfather of Ninigi!

nodes.name: Izanagi & Izanami (Creators of the Japanese Islands)
nodes.notes: Stir the primeval ocean with the heavenly jeweled spear Amenonuhoko to birth Onogoro and the Eight Great Islands of Japan, plus Fire God Kagutsuchi and the Three Noble Children.

nodes.name: Amaterasu-Omikami (Sun Goddess) & Tsukuyomi (Moon)
nodes.role: Supreme Sun Goddess / Ancestress of Japan's Emperors
nodes.notes: Born from Izanagi's left eye upon purifying himself from Yomi (the Underworld); ruler of the High Plain of Heaven (Takamagahara) and divine ancestress of the Imperial House of Japan.

nodes.name: Susanoo-no-Mikoto (+ Kushinadahime) → Okuninushi (Izumo)
nodes.notes: Brother of Amaterasu; slays the eight-headed serpent Yamata-no-Orochi to win the Kusanagi sword, marries Kushinadahime, and sires the Izumo dynasty leading to Okuninushi (who builds Izumo and cedes the land to Amaterasu's grandson Ninigi!).

nodes.name: Ame-no-Oshihomimi & Ninigi-no-Mikoto (+ Konohanasakuya-hime)
nodes.role: Grandson of Amaterasu Bearing the Three Imperial Regalia
nodes.notes: Amaterasu's son Ame-no-Oshihomimi weds Takamimusubi's daughter and sires Ninigi, who descends to Mt. Takachiho (Kyushu) carrying the Mirror, Jewel, and Sword (Three Imperial Regalia) and marries Mt. Fuji goddess Konohanasakuya-hime!

nodes.name: Hoderi & Hoori (+ Toyotama-hime) → Ugayafukiaezu
nodes.notes: Hoori (Yamasachihiko) journeys to the underwater palace of Sea God Ryujin/Watatsumi, weds sea princess Toyotama-hime, and fathers Ugayafukiaezu -> Emperor Jimmu!

nodes.name: Emperor Jimmu (Kamu-yamato Iware-biko, 1st Emperor)
nodes.role: Founder of the Imperial House of Japan (Yamato)
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Ninigi; leads the Eastern Expedition from Kyushu to Yamato (Nara), guided by the three-legged crow Yatagarasu, founding the world's oldest continuous hereditary monarchy!

nodes.name: Emperor Sujin (10th) → Emperor Keiko → Prince Yamato Takeru
nodes.role: First Historical Yamato Anchor & Heroic Prince
nodes.notes: Emperor Sujin is widely regarded as the earliest historically grounded Yamato ruler; his descendant Prince Yamato Takeru wields Susanoo's Kusanagi sword to unify Honshu.

nodes.name: Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku
nodes.role: Yamato Emperors & Architects of Korean/Chinese Cultural Bridge
nodes.notes: Emperor Ojin (deified as Hachiman) welcomed Baekje Korean scholar Wani (bringing Chinese characters and Confucius's Analects to Japan!); Prince Shotoku (574-622 CE) established Buddhism and Japan's 17-Article Constitution!
